title: #1 Einstein
prompt: “The only thing that interferes with my learning is education.” – Albert Einstein. What did he mean by that? Do you think he is correct?

variants.label: Version 1: AGREE
variants.essay:
Learning at school can sometimes block real understanding. In my opinion, I strongly agree with the view that school education can sometimes stop real learning. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

School systems sometimes teach things that do not help people learn for life. In other words, the focus is often on passing tests, not on real knowledge in daily life in daily life today. For example, students may learn dates for a test, but they forget the information later. As a result, the learning is only for the test, not for life. This shows that the system teaches facts, but not how to think.

Another reason is that school life can limit a person's own interests. This is because the school must cover many subjects for all students in daily life in daily life. For example, a student who loves art might have to spend time on hard math lessons. As a result, the student feels that their own interests are not important enough. This supports the view that school limits personal passion.

In conclusion, I strongly agree with the view that school education can sometimes stop real learning. This is because the system focuses on passing tests rather than real knowledge, and it can limit a person's own interests by covering many subjects.

analysis.point1: School systems focus on facts, and the school limits personal passion.
analysis.point2: The essay argues that formal schooling sometimes prevents true, self-directed learning.

For example, students learn to read books and write essays in daily life for many people in many places. As a result, they can share their ideas with others in daily life for many people. title: #2 Healthy Diet
prompt: A healthy diet is more effective for keeping fit than exercise. What is your opinion?

variants.label: Version 1: AGREE
variants.essay:
People often talk about how to keep their body fit. In my opinion, I strongly agree with the view that a healthy diet is more effective for keeping fit than exercise. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

A healthy diet gives the body the right fuel it needs to stay strong. In other words, good food gives us the power to do daily tasks in daily life. For example, eating many fruits and vegetables gives us many vitamins. As a result, our body works well and feels good. This shows that good food is very important for a strong body.

Good food helps the body build muscle and keep bones strong. This is because the right food gives us the building blocks we need in daily life. For example, drinking milk and eating cheese gives us calcium for our bones. As a result, we can move better and feel more active. This supports the view that good food helps us stay fit.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that a healthy diet is more effective for keeping fit than exercise. Good food gives the body the right fuel, and good food helps the body build muscle and keep bones strong.

analysis.point1: A healthy diet provides the necessary fuel and nutrients for the body to function well and maintain strength.
analysis.point2: Proper nutrition supplies the building blocks needed to build strong muscles and keep bones healthy.

variants.label: Version 2: DISAGREE
variants.essay:
Keeping fit needs more than just good food; it also needs movement. In my opinion, I strongly disagree with the view that a healthy diet is more effective for keeping fit than exercise. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

Regular physical activity is very important for keeping the body fit. In other words, moving our bodies helps our muscles and heart work better in daily life. For example, running or playing sports makes our heart move blood well. As a result, we have more energy to do daily tasks. This shows that exercise is key for a strong body.

Diet alone cannot make a person fit enough. This is because the body needs movement to use the energy from the food we eat. For example, if we only eat good food and sit all day, our muscles become weak. As a result, our body does not use the food's energy properly. This supports the view that exercise is needed for fitness.

In conclusion, I strongly disagree with the view that a healthy diet is more effective for keeping fit than exercise. Both regular activity and good food are needed to keep the body fit and support a strong body.

analysis.point1: The essay argues that exercise is equally, if not more, important than diet for fitness.
analysis.point2: The essay uses concrete examples (running, playing sports) and clear effects (more energy, weak muscles) to support the argument.

title: #58 Play Writing

variants.essay:
There are two different views about what high school students should study: writing plays and looking at history. In my opinion, I strongly agree with the view that writing theater plays is more valuable for high school students. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

On the one hand, writing theater plays helps students learn about human feelings. In other words, students must think about how people act in different situations. For example, they write a character who feels sad, and they must show this feeling through words. As a result, students learn to use language to show emotion. This shows that playwriting is a good way to learn about people.

On the other hand, discussing historical writings helps students understand the past. This is because history shows how people lived in earlier times. For example, students read letters from a person who lived long ago, and they learn about that time. As a result, students get a better view of how life was before. This supports the view that history is important for students.

In conclusion, I strongly agree with the view that writing theater plays is more valuable for high school students. This is because playwriting helps students learn about human feelings, and discussing historical writings helps students understand the past.

analysis.point2: Historical writings help students understand the past by showing how people lived in earlier times.

For example, they must give characters different voices and feelings. As a result, students learn to use language in a clear and strong way. This shows that playwriting is good for improving speaking skills.

On the other hand, discussing historical writings gives students knowledge about the past. This is because old writings show how people lived in earlier times. For example, students can read letters from people who lived long ago. As a result, they understand the life of people in different eras. This supports the view that historical writings are important for learning history.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that discussing historical writings is more valuable. While playwriting helps with speaking skills, learning about the past through historical writings gives students important knowledge about history.

title: #199 Communication Change
prompt: The means of communicating in society today has changed greatly over the last ten years. Is it a positive or negative change?

variants.label: Version 1: ADVANTAGES
variants.essay:
The ways people talk to each other have changed a lot in the last ten years. In my opinion, I strongly positive with the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

On the one hand, modern communication makes it easy to talk to people far away. In other words, we can connect with friends and family across many countries in daily life. For example, a phone call or a video chat lets us see people we miss in daily life. As a result, people can keep in touch even if they live far apart. This shows that communication methods help people stay connected.

On the other hand, this change brings some problems with communication. This is because people might spend too much time looking at screens in daily life. For example, some people forget how to talk face to face in daily life. As a result, real-life talking skills might get worse for some people. This supports the view that there are negative aspects to new communication.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that the changes are positive. Modern communication makes it easy to talk to people far away, but it also brings problems with communication.

For example, using video calls lets families see each other in daily life for many people. As a result, people feel closer to their loved ones in daily life. This shows that technology makes talking simple for many people.

On the other hand, there is a negative side to these changes. This is because people might talk less face to face in daily life for many people. For example, students might use phones instead of talking to friends in daily life for many people. As a result, people lose skills in talking to others in person in daily life. This supports the view that too much screen time is a problem.

In conclusion, I strongly negative with the disadvantages outweigh the advantages. This is because technology helps people connect easily, but it also causes people to talk less face to face.

variants.essay:
Youth crime is a serious problem in many communities today. In my opinion, I strongly agree with identifying problems and proposing solutions. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

The major reason is that young people lack proper guidance. In other words, they do not know how to manage their feelings or time in daily life for many people. For example, some teenagers spend too much time on the street in daily life for many people. As a result, they might get into trouble with other people in daily life for many people. This shows that good guidance is very important for young people.

One effective solution is to improve school programs. This is because schools can teach life skills and good behavior in daily life for many people. For example, schools can run classes about conflict resolution in daily life for many people. As a result, students will feel more ready for adult life in daily life for many people. This supports the view that education helps solve this issue.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that identifying problems and proposing solutions is necessary. We must address the lack of proper guidance and improve school programs to help youth.

analysis.point2: One effective solution is to improve school programs by teaching life skills and good behavior, making students ready for adult life.

For instance, some students from poor families might drop out of school because they need to work immediately. As a result, these youths may join criminal groups for money, which is very dangerous. The outcome is that young people feel supervised and have positive role models in their lives. This clearly aligns with the view that proactive community action is necessary for prevention.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that identifying problems and proposing solutions is vital. By addressing the lack of proper education and by improving community involvement, we can make a positive change in tackling youth crime.

variants.label: Version 1: AGREE
variants.essay:
Some people think that college courses should teach more real-life skills instead of just book knowledge. In my opinion, I strongly agree with agreeing with the statement. This essay will provide two reasons supporting my idea.

Focusing on practical skills is very important for students. In other words, students need to learn how to do things in the real world in daily life. For example, a student who studies cooking should learn to cook in a real kitchen in daily life. As a result, they will feel ready for a job when they finish school in daily life. This shows that practical training helps students get ready for work.

Learning practical skills helps students find good jobs. This is because employers look for people who can work right away in daily life. For example, a computer science student should do projects on real company problems in daily life. As a result, the student has useful experience for their future career in daily life. This supports the view that practical training is very helpful for job searching.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that college should focus on practical skills. Giving students useful experience and practical training makes them better prepared for their careers.

analysis.point1: Practical training is crucial because it prepares students for the demands of the real world and makes them job-ready upon graduation.
analysis.point2: Acquiring practical skills helps students secure good jobs because employers value candidates who can contribute immediately.

variants.essay:

University education must give students a strong base of knowledge. In other words, knowledge helps students think clearly and solve problems in daily life for many people. For example, a student must learn history to understand current events in daily life. As a result, they can make good choices in life in daily life. This shows that academic study is very important for a good life.

Practical training is useful, but academic study gives students important thinking skills. This is because learning facts and ideas helps the mind grow strong in daily life for many people. For example, a science student must read many books to learn the rules in daily life. As a result, they can understand complex ideas better in daily life. This supports the view that academic study is necessary for success.

In conclusion, I strongly disagree with the idea that universities should change their focus. Universities must give students a strong base of knowledge, and academic study is necessary for success.

For example, a company can pay for a worker to take a course on digital marketing in daily life. As a result, the worker can use modern skills and help the company grow. This supports the view that giving workers training is a good idea.

In conclusion, I strongly agree with identifying problems and proposing solutions. This is because long-term jobs can make workers less skilled, and companies should offer training programs to help workers learn new skills.

The major reason is that people spend too much time online. In other words, using social media takes up many hours each day in daily life. For example, students might spend all their free time looking at pictures in daily life. As a result, they do not have time for hobbies or family time in daily life. For example, a person can decide to only check the apps after dinner in daily life. As a result, they keep their focus on real-life activities during the day in daily life. This supports the view that setting limits helps people manage their time.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that identifying problems and proposing solutions is important. We must manage the time online and set clear time limits to achieve a good balance.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that identifying problems and proposing solutions is helpful. Managing study time is a key problem, and good support is an effective solution for students.
